indicator_name: Share of respondents who use AI tools in their development process
question_text: Do you currently use AI tools in your development process?
numerator_categories: Yes, I use AI tools daily;Yes, I use AI tools weekly;Yes, I use AI tools monthly or infrequently
notes: "No, but I plan to soon" counts as NOT using (it is intention; see BX1).

indicator_name: Share who use AI tools daily
question_text: Do you currently use AI tools in your development process?
numerator_categories: Yes, I use AI tools daily
denominator_rule: Valid AISelect answers (same denominator as B1)
notes: Denominator is all valid answers, not AI users only (Think4Ever definition).

indicator_name: Share who use AI agents at work
question_text: Are you using AI agents in your work (development or otherwise)?  AI agents refer to autonomous software entities that can operate with minimal to no direct human intervention using artificial intelligence techniques.
numerator_categories: Yes, I use AI agents at work daily;Yes, I use AI agents at work weekly;Yes, I use AI agents at work monthly or infrequently
notes: "AI exclusively in copilot/autocomplete mode" is NOT agent use; "No, but I plan to" is intention (BX2).

indicator_name: Development environments and AI-enabled editors used regularly in the past year
question_text: Which development environments and AI-enabled code editing tools did you use regularly over the past year, and which do you want to work with over the next year? Please check all that apply.
numerator_categories: each option (27); headline VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf (Think4Ever comparables) + AI-native editors: Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Cline and/or Roo, Aider, Trae, Bolt, Lovable.dev, Zed
denominator_rule: Respondents with a non-null DevEnvsHaveWorkedWith answer
notes: Multi-select: shares do not add to 100%. Same denominator as the original Think4Ever B4.

indicator_name: LLM model families used for development work
question_text: Which LLM models for AI tools have you used for development work in the past year, and which would you like to use next year? Select all that apply.
denominator_rule: Respondents with a non-null AIModelsHaveWorkedWith answer

indicator_name: Out-of-the-box agents, copilots or assistants used
question_text: You indicated you use or develop AI agents as part of your development work.  Have you used any of the following out-of-the-box agents, copilots or assistants?
denominator_rule: Respondents with a non-null AIAgentExternal answer (asked only of agent users/developers)

indicator_name: Respondents (n), valid n per question and confidence
denominator_rule: Not applicable (count of respondents meeting the group definition)
notes: Template rule: low confidence below 300 respondents. Valid n reported for every indicator.

indicator_name: Non-users who plan to start using AI tools soon
question_text: Do you currently use AI tools in your development process?
numerator_categories: No, but I plan to soon
denominator_rule: Valid AISelect answers; also shown as share of non-users

indicator_name: Non-users of agents who plan to use agents
question_text: Are you using AI agents in your work (development or otherwise)?  AI agents refer to autonomous software entities that can operate with minimal to no direct human intervention using artificial intelligence techniques.
notes: Copilot-only users reported as their own category.

indicator_name: Editors/AI tools respondents want to work with next year
question_text: Which development environments and AI-enabled code editing tools did you use regularly over the past year, and which do you want to work with over the next year? Please check all that apply.
denominator_rule: Respondents with a non-null DevEnvsWantToWorkWith answer

concept: Adoption by task + intention by task
indicator_name: For each development task: currently using AI (partially or mostly) / plan to use AI / do not plan
question_text: Which parts of your development workflow are you currently integrating into AI or using AI tools to accomplish or plan to use AI to accomplish over the next 3 - 5 years?  Please select one for each scenario.
numerator_categories: task listed under the stance column
denominator_rule: Respondents who placed that task in any of the 5 stance columns
notes: Task-specific denominators (14 tasks). Highly relevant to Think4Ever: "Learning about a codebase", "Committing and reviewing code", "Documenting code".

indicator_name: Favourable stance towards AI tools in the workflow
question_text: How favorable is your stance on using AI tools as part of your development workflow?
denominator_rule: Valid AISent answers ("Unsure" kept in the denominator)
notes: Full 6-category distribution reported. Sentiment is not adoption.

indicator_name: Trust in the accuracy of AI output (and distrust)
question_text: How much do you trust the accuracy of the output from AI tools as part of your development workflow?
notes: Distrust share (Somewhat + Highly distrust) reported alongside.

question_text: How well do the AI tools you use in your development workflow handle complex tasks?
numerator_categories: Very well at handling complex tasks;Good, but not great at handling complex tasks
notes: "I don't use AI tools for complex tasks / I don't know" reported separately and kept in the denominator.

indicator_name: AI tools or agents changed how development work is done
question_text: Have AI tools or AI agents changed how you complete development work in the past year?
numerator_categories: Yes, to a great extent;Yes, somewhat

question_text: When using AI tools, which of the following problems or frustrations have you encountered? Select all that apply.
denominator_rule: Respondents with a non-null AIFrustration answer
notes: Includes "It’s hard to understand how or why the code works" and "Debugging AI-generated code is more time-consuming": the problem Think4Ever addresses.

concept: Purchase influence (behaviour, not intent to buy Think4Ever)
indicator_name: Influenced or endorsed a technology purchase in the past year
question_text: Have you influenced or endorsed a new technology purchase at your organization or sole proprietor job in the past year?
numerator_categories: Yes, I influenced the purchase of a substantial addition to the tech stack;Yes, I influenced the purchase of a tool that more than five colleagues use but it is not a substantial addition to the tech stack;Yes, I endorsed a tool that was open-source and is currently used by more than just myself but no purchase was made;Yes, I endorsed a tool that was ultimately not purchased or used at my organization
notes: Also reported: influenced a paid purchase (first two categories).

indicator_name: Believes AI is a threat to current job
question_text: Do you believe AI is a threat to your current job?

indicator_name: Learned AI-enabled tools in the past year (for job/career or curiosity)
question_text: Did you spend time in the last year learning AI programming or AI-enabled tooling on your own or at work?
numerator_categories: Yes, I learned how to use AI-enabled tools required for my job or to benefit my career;Yes, I learned how to use AI-enabled tools for my personal curiosity and/or hobbies
